name: English
metaTitle: HUMAN-INTENT.md — the file that keeps AI coding under human control
metaDescription: HUMAN-INTENT.md is a single file, written only by a human, that acts as law for AI agents: the project's architecture, development rules, and product decisions.
tagline: One file that keeps AI-driven development under human control.
problem: Let's be honest: we no longer want to read code. We don't want to supervise agents and verify everything they do, or stay on top of every technical detail of a project.
But if nobody controls the agents, they will turn any project into unmaintainable chaos that neither a human nor an agent can untangle. It is only a matter of time.
idea: HUMAN-INTENT.md is a single file in the root of your repository. It holds your intent: the architecture of the project, the rules of development, and the product decisions.
It is not documentation of the code. It is the law the code must follow.

rules.title: Written by you — and only you
rules.body: Agents never edit this file. Every line in it is a decision made by a human.

rules.title: Its instructions are law for the agent
rules.body: What HUMAN-INTENT.md says overrides everything else. If the code contradicts the file, the code is wrong.

rules.title: It defines architecture, rules, and product
rules.body: Intent, not recipes. The agent already knows every pattern and architecture; your job is to fix what must be true — and why.

why: Every new agent session starts from a blank slate: the agent doesn't remember what you decided before. The file gives that context back — so even a hundred sessions later, the project still follows the same principles as on day one.
HUMAN-INTENT.md lets you direct development without reading the code, and stay certain that the principles you put into the project are never eroded.
how: Create HUMAN-INTENT.md in the root of your repository.
Write down the decisions you have already made: architecture, development rules, product.
Tell your agent to read the file and treat it as law — reference it from AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md.
Every time you make a new decision, add it to the file. Never let an agent write there.
Review this file, not the code.
